evidenceBoundary.reason: The run observed a live worktree while installation-readiness fixes were landing. The log has no immutable revision marker at its start and therefore cannot prove that all 324 checks exercised one revision.
evidenceBoundary.interpretation: Individual results are useful diagnostic observations, but the aggregate is not release acceptance for the final clean revision. No individual failure is attributed to a revision unless the log itself records one.

categories.evidence: The outer spawnSync budget expired with ETIMEDOUT. This proves budget exhaustion only; it does not by itself identify disk, crypto, migration, or application logic as the root cause.
The test could not observe the isolated local service listening, or could not verify its child exit. These failures share an availability symptom but not a proven common root cause.
Six isolated renderer runs reached an EDGE_RUNNER_TIMEOUT and one lifecycle check failed closed because process identity could not be verified. This is separate from the sidecar readiness symptom.

sensitiveContentAudit.policy: Counts and categories only; no matched values are reproduced here.
sensitiveContentAudit.archiveRequirement: Before sharing or archiving outside the local workspace, replace local absolute paths and temporary/evidence locations. Retain long hexadecimal values only when explicitly needed as build or file digests; otherwise replace them.

recommendedControlledFollowUp: Do not increase timeouts or weaken durability, ACL, fencing, or process-identity checks based on this aggregate alone.
Run the new opt-in startup diagnostics on a small representative sidecar failure first, preserving only bounded phase names and approved numeric fields.
Rerun each outer ETIMEDOUT suite individually on the final clean revision and distinguish progress, phase timing, assertion failure, and outer-budget exhaustion.
Clear or account for retained isolated browser resources before rerunning the WebView lifecycle subset; keep identity verification fail-closed.
Only after targeted diagnosis, run a clean, immutable-revision full regression and record the revision at both start and finish.
